To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NJL-jet model can be extended to describe the fragmentation of a quark into a hadron and a jet.
the NJL‐ jet model provides a framework to compute dihadron fragmentation without introducing any ad hoc parameters.
The fragmentation functions for dihadrons in the NJL jet model are consistent with the data from the LHC.
